title: Thirty Weeks atop Call Volume, Still One Hurdle from Making Money: Two Rankings for Domestic Models
excerpt: OpenRouter's weekly rankings present a contradiction: from November 16 to 22, total global large-model usage reached 210 trillion tokens, up 8.25% week over wee
content_html:
OpenRouter's weekly rankings present a contradiction: from November 16 to 22, total global large-model usage reached 210 trillion tokens, up 8.25% week over week; Chinese models' processing volume beat US models for the 30th consecutive week to rank first, but the stars of the spending leaderboard are still overseas models.

Usage Leaderboard: Six of the Top Nine

At the vendor level, DeepSeek, Zhipu, and Tencent swept the top four: DeepSeek V4.1-Flash-1017 ranked first for five consecutive weeks, with 65 trillion tokens in weekly usage; the company's own V4.1 Flash came in second with 15.4 trillion; Zhipu GLM 5.3 Flash was third with 12.2 trillion; Tencent Hunyuan Hy4 flash was fourth with 10.2 trillion. The six Chinese models totaled 111.16 trillion, a slight week-over-week decline, while the three US models totaled 19.21 trillion, up nearly 30%. A year ago, weekly usage was only 7.18 trillion, and MiniMax M2 was the only Chinese model in the top nine; now the total has grown more than 28-fold, and on the monthly leaderboard the same DeepSeek model took the crown with 226 trillion, up more than 7-fold.

Spending Leaderboard: Claude's Turf

The spending leaderboard tells a different story: software tasks account for 40.2% of total platform spending, and Anthropic's Claude swept the top spot in most categories. Looking only at code implementation tasks, which account for 16.2% of total spending, Claude Opus 5.5 ranked first with 22%, Kimi K3.1 Pro was second with 10.1%, and DeepSeek was sixth with only 5.2%. OpenRouter only counts traffic routed through its own platform, which is not the same as global share. The conclusion is clear: Chinese models have entered developer workflows, but they have not yet passed the money-making test.
